Subject: Evidence request — PR gating & secrets handling (FinBank SOC2 scope)

Hi Grace,

Following our scoping call, FinBank's external assessor needs concrete evidence for the following SDLC controls in scope for SOC 2 and SIG:

- Branch protection rules and PR gating policy (who can merge, required approvals, status checks)
- Audit log of PR gate runs for the last 90 days (fail/pass history)
- CI configuration showing required status checks and who can bypass (if any)
- Secrets management flow: ephemeral credential issuance, vault escrow process for emergency rollbacks, KMS rotation cadence
- Change approval chronology for the last two high-risk releases (who approved, dates, rollback authorization)

Would you be able to provide the artifacts or point us at a secure bucket/drive where we can fetch them? We prefer CSV/PDF for logs and a short narrative mapping each artifact to the control criteria.

Our target is to complete the evidence pull by 2026-11-23 to stay on the audit timeline. Please let me know any blockers.

Thanks,
Liam Chen
Senior Assessor — FinBank Assurance Team

Hi all —

Per Grace's plan, I've exported the 90-day PR gate audit from GitHub Enterprise. The CSV includes: PR id, source branch, target branch, required status checks at time of merge, approvers, merge result, and timestamp. Redacted personal emails for public disclosure have been replaced by approver IDs.

Also included: current branch protection policy (PDF) showing required review count, code owner rules, and admin bypass exceptions (none configured).

Stubs / attachments included in this thread (full files uploaded to shared drive link below):
- pr-gate-audit-2026-10.csv (contains 342 entries for period)
- branch-protection-policy.pdf

Notes:
- We enforce protected branches on main and release/* with required status checks and at least 2 approvers for main.
- Emergency bypass is only via an OPS postmortem workflow (ticket + two senior approvals) — we will attach the SOP excerpt in the next message.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/FinBank/SDLC_evidence/pr-gate-audit-2026-10

Hi Liam / team —

I've pulled the CI configuration (YAML excerpts) showing required status checks: unit-tests, lint, integration-smoke, and security-scan. I've attached a small sample CI job run log (ci-job-log-sample.txt) that demonstrates how runs are annotated and how gating prevents merges on failed checks.

Secrets handling: short summary and artifacts uploaded:
- secrets-rotation-timeline.csv — lists KMS key rotation dates, vault credential rotation cadence (ephemeral tokens issued for runners), and the emergency escrow matrix (who can request escrow + ticketing ID pattern).
- We use short-lived workload identities for runners; static tokens are stored only in HSM-backed vault with access strictly audited.

I also created OPS-4123 (https://jira.redwood.com/browse/OPS-4123) which contains the change approval entries for the two releases you asked about; it includes approval timestamps and reviewer IDs. If you need signed approver names rather than IDs we can add a redacted mapping exported under restricted access.

Jordan Blake
